messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians will enjoy in **2023**.  
(“Long weekend” means the statutory holiday falls on a Thursday or Friday, giving you an extra day off.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Why it’s a long weekend |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|
| **Good Friday** | **April 7** (Friday) | Friday + Saturday‑Sunday weekend → 3‑day break |
| **Remembrance Day** | **November 11** (Thursday) | Thursday + Friday + Saturday‑Sunday weekend → 4‑day break |
| **Boxing Day** | **December 26** (Tuesday) | Monday (Christmas) + Tuesday (Boxing) + Wednesday → 5‑day break |

> **Note:**  
> • Most other federal holidays in Canada fall on Mondays (e.g., Victoria Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving) or on weekends (e.g., New Year’s Day, Canada Day, Christmas Day). Those don’t create a “long weekend” unless you take an extra day off.  
> • Provincial holidays such as Family Day (all provinces) are scheduled on the third Monday in February, so they don’t add a long weekend either.

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
